content: Open-source password managers benefit from public audits (Bitwarden commissions regular third-party audits; KeePass CVE-2023-32784 memory-dump vuln was found and patched quickly because code was open). Most severe cloud password-manager vulnerabilities found by ETH Zurich required server compromise. Rolling your own crypto is broadly discouraged: memory-management bugs are the most common vulnerability class in custom crypto implementations, and small deviations from a proven construction can silently break security while still 'working' for benign inputs.
